title: 2.1.3 Wheat Production and Management
description: Wheat: origin, production practices, management and yield

questions.question: What is the scientific name of wheat?

options: The Asian continent, mainly in China, Pakistan and India
questions.correctAnswer: The Asian continent, mainly in China, Pakistan and India

questions.question: How is wheat ranked among cereal crops globally?
options: It is the most important cereal, followed by rice and maize
It is the third most important cereal, after maize and rice
It is the most important cereal, followed by maize and teff
It ranks behind sorghum and millet in global importance
questions.correctAnswer: It is the most important cereal, followed by rice and maize

Heavy clay soils that hold excess moisture

questions.correctAnswer: Well drained, loamy and fertile soils

questions.question: What indicates that wheat is ready for harvest?
options: It dries to a golden yellow colour with no green parts left
The grains develop a black layer at the bottom tip
The stems and panicle turn yellow while still green

questions.correctAnswer: It dries to a golden yellow colour with no green parts left
